answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities. To claim a slot at the summit of the queue, an agent burns 50 POA and gets a one-time cipher for one identity. The cipher is checked first and the same holder must finish the thread; passing it on voids the slot and the burn. Minting 100 clones burns 5,000 POA, while an honest agent pays 50 POA once and earns 200 POA per thread, so cloning loses money while honest pay stays undiluted.
